mentions.name: OG+
mentions.description: This service creates unique Open Graph images for each page on a website. It screenshots the page, allowing the displayed content to be customized with CSS, Tailwind classes, meta tags, or HTML templates, and generates differently sized images per social network so each network gets an image optimized for its previews. Websites only need to deploy a few meta tags; the service's servers process the tags, take screenshots, and serve the images.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on https://og.plus, a service that creates unique Open Graph images per page on a website.
